chunks: When Isma'il ibn Ja'far died, al-Sadiq عليه السلام came out and went ahead of the bier without shoes and without an outer garment.

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلُ: Isma'il, the deceased person mentioned in the report
key_terms.السَّرِيرَ: the bier or funeral couch carried in the procession
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: al-Sadiq, Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.مَاتَ: died; indicates the occurrence of death

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام act during the funeral of Isma'il ibn Ja'far?
ai.summary: This report describes the conduct of al-Sadiq عليه السلام at the death of Isma'il ibn Ja'far. It depicts a visible expression of grief and participation in the funeral procession with marked simplicity and mourning.
